      "title": "Class: incomplete-item. Where: metasystem/internal/steward/claim_quota.go. If the holding goal has a unit that is settled but not 'collected and published', the claim-quota ask is withheld for the whole blocking interval. That covers a dropped unit, a dropped goal-branch commit, and a commit whose reads are waived and is ready to land. Such a goal has no work in flight, and this is exactly when the goal's Intent and design D13 require the holder to be asked once. The in-flight gate is an allow-list of three stage prefixes and treats every other stage as busy, including these settled ones. As a result a goal that once dropped a unit is never asked to release the machine's one claim again, while ready priority-1 work waits behind it. The page shows only 'not yet asked'. Change: treat the settled stages as not in flight, either by adding the 'dropped' prefix and 'committed, ready to land without a read' to the settled set, or better by listing the stages that really are in flight (starting, running, built or committed ready for review, under examination, collected but not yet published, drop pending, stopped needing a revision).
